messages.content: Every 17th word of your response must be in Japanese. What are some fun true or false questions to give to students? They are to be used to introduce a new teacher.

message.content: Here are some engaging questions. Do you like coffee? The answer is true. 本当です。 Are you a cat person? Most students say yes. 猫が好き。 Can you touch your nose with your tongue? This one is false. できません。 Did the teacher eat lunch? Check the time now. 昼食を食べた。 Is the sky blue today? Look outside carefully please. 青いです。 Can humans fly without help? Obviously that is false. 飛べない。 Does the school have a library? Verify this fact quickly. 図書館があります。 Is chocolate made from beans? Yes, cocoa beans indeed. ココア豆。 Can you see colors in dreams? Many people believe true. 夢で見る。
